conditions: All required fields filled with valid values
items.expected: Account is created and customer is taken to the sign-in page

conditions: Each required field left empty in turn while others are valid
items.expected: A message appears at the empty field and no account is created

conditions: Password that violates the stated password rules (e.g. too short, missing required character class)
items.expected: Registration is refused with a message that names the broken rule

conditions: axe-core scan of the registration form with WCAG A/AA rules
items.expected: No accessibility violations reported by axe-core

excluded.reason: Admin product search — entirely unrelated to customer registration; does not touch any AC of this story
Billing address at checkout — entirely unrelated to customer registration; does not touch any AC of this story
Registration does not imply account-enumeration or session risks beyond what sign-in covers (tested under TOOL-13); no security criterion stated in this story
No open bugs touch this story's behaviour; both open bugs (TOOL-20, TOOL-21) are about unrelated features
